intent: Bring kcd2_dice_solver/src/core/scoring.ts (361 lines) under the repo-wide 250-line cap with no change to Farkle scoring, so every roll still scores identically.

Moved ScoringConfig to scoringMoves.ts, since it is exactly the generator's parameter object; Scorer imports the type and still builds it in its constructor.

Function bodies moved verbatim; the only edit inside them was threading `config` as a parameter where the method previously read this.config, so no statement was added or removed.
